features.name: Rage
features.description: Enter Rage as a Bonus Action without Heavy armor. While raging, resist Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; gain Advantage on Strength checks and saves; and add Rage Damage to Strength-based weapon or Unarmed Strike damage (+2 at levels 1-8, +3 at 9-15, +4 at 16-20). You cannot cast spells or concentrate. The rage lasts until the end of your next turn and can be extended each round by attacking, forcing an enemy save, or using a Bonus Action, up to 10 minutes. Uses: 2 at levels 1-2, 3 at 3-5, 4 at 6-11, 5 at 12-16, 6 at 17+. Recover one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor, your base AC is 10 + Dexterity modifier + Constitution modifier. You may still use a Shield.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose two Simple or Martial Melee weapon kinds whose mastery properties you can use. Replace one choice after a Long Rest. The number of chosen kinds increases to three at level 4 and four at level 10.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: On your first attack roll of a turn, choose to attack recklessly. Strength-based attack rolls have Advantage until your next turn, but attacks against you also have Advantage.

features.name: Barbarian Subclass
features.description: Choose a Barbarian subclass; gain its features at the listed Barbarian levels.

features.name: Primal Knowledge
features.description: Gain one more skill proficiency from the Barbarian level 1 list. While raging, you can use Strength for Acrobatics, Intimidation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival checks.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Barbarian levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your Speed increases by {{distance:10ft}} while you are not wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Feral Instinct
features.description: You have Advantage on Initiative rolls.

features.name: Instinctive Pounce
features.description: As part of the Bonus Action used to enter Rage, move up to half your Speed.

features.name: Brutal Strike
features.description: When using Reckless Attack, forgo its Advantage on one Strength-based attack without Disadvantage. If that attack hits, add 1d10 damage of the attack's type and choose a Brutal Strike effect: Forceful Blow pushes the target {{distance:15ft}} and lets you follow up to half your Speed without Opportunity Attacks; Hamstring Blow reduces its Speed by {{distance:15ft}} until your next turn.

features.name: Relentless Rage
features.description: If Rage is active and you would drop to 0 HP without dying outright, make a DC 10 Constitution save. On success, your HP becomes twice your Barbarian level. The DC increases by 5 after each use and resets after a Short or Long Rest.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: Gain two more Brutal Strike effects: Staggering Blow gives the target Disadvantage on its next save and prevents Opportunity Attacks until your next turn; Sundering Blow gives the next other creature to attack it a +5 attack bonus before your next turn.

features.name: Persistent Rage
features.description: Once per Long Rest when rolling Initiative, recover all expended Rage uses. Rage no longer needs actions to extend it; it lasts up to 10 minutes, ending early only if you become Unconscious or wear Heavy armor.

features.name: Improved Brutal Strike
features.description: Brutal Strike's extra damage becomes 2d10, and you can apply two different Brutal Strike effects to the hit.

features.name: Indomitable Might
features.description: If a Strength check or Strength saving throw total is lower than your Strength score, use your Strength score instead.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Increase Strength and Constitution by 4 each; their maximum becomes 25.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: As a Bonus Action, give a creature within {{distance:60ft}} that can see or hear you a Bardic Inspiration die. Within 1 hour after failing a D20 Test, it can roll the die and add it to that test. A creature holds only one such die. Uses equal Charisma modifier (minimum 1), restored on a Long Rest. Die size: d6 at levels 1-4, d8 at 5-9, d10 at 10-14, d12 at 15+.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your Bard spellcasting ability; a Musical Instrument can be your focus. Know two Bard cantrips at level 1, gaining another at levels 4 and 10. Prepare four level 1 Bard spells at level 1; the number prepared and spell slots grow with Bard level. On gaining a Bard level, you may replace one prepared spell and one cantrip with eligible Bard spells. Always-prepared spells from other features do not count against the limit.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two proficient skills; gain Expertise in two more at Bard level 9.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, to a skill-based ability check that does not otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus if you lack that skill proficiency.

features.name: Bard Subclass
features.description: Choose a Bard subclass; gain its features at the listed Bard levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Bard levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.description: Regain all Bardic Inspiration uses on a Short or Long Rest. You may expend a spell slot, without an action, to regain one use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.description: As a Reaction when you or a creature within {{distance:30ft}} fails a save against Charmed or Frightened, cause that save to be rerolled with Advantage.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.description: When your prepared-spell allowance increases, new spells may come from the Bard, Cleric, Druid, or Wizard lists and count as Bard spells. You may also replace a prepared Bard spell with one from those lists.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.description: When you roll Initiative with fewer than two Bardic Inspiration uses remaining, regain enough to have two.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.description: Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill are always prepared. When casting either, you may target a second creature within {{distance:10ft}} of the first.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your Cleric spellcasting ability; a Holy Symbol can be your focus. Know three Cleric cantrips at level 1, with another at levels 4 and 10. Prepare four level 1 Cleric spells at level 1; preparation limit and spell slots grow with Cleric level. After each Long Rest, you may change any prepared Cleric spells for spells of levels you can cast. Always-prepared spells do not count against the limit.

features.name: Divine Order
features.description: Choose Protector for Martial weapon proficiency and Heavy armor training, or Thaumaturge for one extra Cleric cantrip and a bonus to Arcana or Religion checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1).

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Gain Divine Spark and Turn Undead, plus subclass options. Use Channel Divinity twice at level 2, three times at level 6, and four times at level 18; regain one use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. As a Magic action, Divine Spark heals another creature you can see within {{distance:30ft}} for 1d8 + Wisdom modifier or deals that amount of Necrotic or Radiant damage on a failed Constitution save (half on success); the dice increase to 2d8 at level 7, 3d8 at 13, and 4d8 at 18. As a Magic action, Turn Undead forces chosen Undead within {{distance:30ft}} to make Wisdom saves or become Frightened and Incapacitated for 1 minute; they try to move away, and the effect ends if they take damage or you become Incapacitated or die.

features.name: Cleric Subclass
features.description: Choose a Cleric subclass; gain its features at the listed Cleric levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Cleric levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Sear Undead
features.description: When you use Turn Undead, each Undead that fails its save also takes Radiant damage equal to a roll of d8s numbering your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1d8).

features.name: Blessed Strikes
features.description: Choose Divine Strike, adding 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage to one weapon hit on each of your turns, or Potent Spellcasting, adding your Wisdom modifier to Cleric cantrip damage.

features.name: Divine Intervention
features.description: Once per Long Rest, take a Magic action to cast a Cleric spell of level 5 or lower that does not require a Reaction, without a slot or Material components.

features.name: Improved Blessed Strikes
features.description: Divine Strike's extra damage becomes 2d8. If you chose Potent Spellcasting instead, damaging a creature with a Cleric cantrip can grant you or an ally within {{distance:60ft}} Temporary HP equal to twice your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Greater Divine Intervention
features.description: Divine Intervention can cast Wish. If you choose Wish, you cannot use Divine Intervention again until you finish 2d4 Long Rests.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your Druid spellcasting ability; a Druidic Focus can be your focus. Know two Druid cantrips at level 1, gaining another at levels 4 and 10. Prepare four level 1 Druid spells at level 1; preparation limit and spell slots grow with Druid level. After each Long Rest, you may replace prepared Druid spells with others of levels you can cast. Always-prepared spells do not count against the limit.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: Know the secret Druidic language and always have Speak with Animals prepared. You can leave hidden Druidic messages; other Druids notice them automatically, while others need a DC 15 Investigation check to spot but cannot decipher them without magic.

features.name: Primal Order
features.description: Choose Magician for one extra Druid cantrip and a bonus to Arcana or Nature checks equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum +1), or Warden for Martial weapon proficiency and Medium armor training.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: As a Bonus Action, take one of your known Beast forms for half your Druid level in hours. Start with four forms of CR 1/4 or less and no Fly Speed; at level 4 know six forms up to CR 1/2, at level 8 eight forms up to CR 1 and Fly Speed becomes eligible. Replace a known form after a Long Rest. Retain HP, Hit Dice, mental abilities, class features, languages, and proficiencies; gain Temporary HP equal to Druid level. You cannot cast spells in Beast form but can maintain concentration. Start with two uses; recover one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Uses rise to three at level 6 and four at level 17.

features.name: Wild Companion
features.description: Spend a spell slot or one Wild Shape use as a Magic action to cast Find Familiar without Material components. The familiar is Fey and disappears after your next Long Rest.

features.name: Druid Subclass
features.description: Choose a Druid subclass; gain its features at the listed Druid levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Druid levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Wild Resurgence
features.description: Once per turn when out of Wild Shape uses, spend a spell slot to regain one use. Once per Long Rest, spend one Wild Shape use to regain a level 1 spell slot.

features.name: Elemental Fury
features.description: Choose Potent Spellcasting to add your Wisdom modifier to Druid cantrip damage, or Primal Strike to add 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage to one weapon or Wild Shape Beast attack hit on each of your turns.

features.name: Improved Elemental Fury
features.description: Potent Spellcasting adds {{distance:300ft}} to a Druid cantrip's range if it normally reaches at least {{distance:10ft}}. Primal Strike's extra damage becomes 2d8.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast spells while Wild Shaped, except those with a priced Material component or a Material component the spell consumes.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: When you roll Initiative with no Wild Shape uses left, regain one. Once per Long Rest, convert unspent Wild Shape uses into a single spell slot at two spell levels per use. You also age only one year for every ten years that pass.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat of your choice. Whenever you gain a Fighter level, you may replace it with a different Fighting Style feat.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: As a Bonus Action, regain 1d10 + Fighter level Hit Points. Start with two uses; gain a third at level 4 and a fourth at level 10. Recover one use on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose three Simple or Martial weapon kinds whose mastery properties you can use. Change one choice after a Long Rest. The number rises to four at level 4, five at level 10, and six at level 16.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: On your turn, take one additional action other than the Magic action. Recover on a Short or Long Rest. At level 17, you have two uses per rest, but can use it only once per turn.

features.name: Tactical Mind
features.description: After failing an ability check, spend a Second Wind use to add 1d10 to the check. If the check still fails, the use is not spent.

features.name: Fighter Subclass
features.description: Choose a Fighter subclass; gain its features at the listed Fighter levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Fighter levels 6, 8, 12, 14, and 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice when you take the Attack action. This improves at Fighter levels 11 and 20.

features.name: Tactical Shift
features.description: When you activate Second Wind as a Bonus Action, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Indomitable
features.description: After failing a saving throw, reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level; use the new roll. One use per Long Rest at level 9, two at 13, and three at 17.

features.name: Tactical Master
features.description: When attacking with a weapon whose mastery you can use, replace its mastery property for that attack with Push, Sap, or Slow.

features.name: Two Extra Attacks
features.description: Attack three times, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Studied Attacks
features.description: After missing a creature with an attack roll, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Three Extra Attacks
features.description: Attack four times, rather than once, whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: While unarmored, without a Shield, and unarmed or wielding only Monk weapons (Simple Melee or Light Martial Melee weapons), you may make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action, use Dexterity for their attack and damage rolls and your Grapple/Shove save DC, and replace normal damage with your Martial Arts die. The die is d6 at levels 1-4, d8 at 5-10, d10 at 11-16, and d12 at 17+.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: Without armor or a Shield, base AC equals 10 + Dexterity modifier + Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Monk's Focus
features.description: You have Focus Points equal to your Monk level, recovered after a Short or Long Rest; Focus save DC is 8 + Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus. Spend 1 point for Flurry of Blows (two Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action), or take Disengage or Dash as a Bonus Action for free. Spend 1 point to combine Disengage with Dodge (Patient Defense) or Dash (Step of the Wind, also doubling jump distance) as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Without armor or Shield, Speed rises by {{distance:10ft}} at levels 2-5, {{distance:15ft}} at 6-9, {{distance:20ft}} at 10-13, {{distance:25ft}} at 14-17, and {{distance:30ft}} at 18+.

features.name: Uncanny Metabolism
features.description: Once per Long Rest when you roll Initiative, regain all Focus Points and heal Monk level + one Martial Arts die roll.

features.name: Deflect Attacks
features.description: As a Reaction when an attack hits and includes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, reduce total damage by 1d10 + Dexterity modifier + Monk level. If reduced to 0, spend 1 Focus Point to redirect it: a visible creature within {{distance:5ft}} for a melee attack, or within {{distance:60ft}} and not behind Total Cover for a ranged attack, makes a Dexterity save or takes two Martial Arts dice + Dexterity modifier damage of the attack's type.

features.name: Monk Subclass
features.description: Choose a Monk subclass; gain its features at the listed Monk levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Monk levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Slow Fall
features.description: As a Reaction while falling, reduce fall damage by five times your Monk level.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Stunning Strike
features.description: Once per turn after hitting with a Monk weapon or Unarmed Strike, spend 1 Focus Point. The target makes a Constitution save: failure Stuns it until the start of your next turn; success halves its Speed and gives the next attack against it Advantage until then.

features.name: Empowered Strikes
features.description: Your Unarmed Strike can deal Force damage instead of its normal damage type.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: On a Dexterity save for half damage, take no damage on success and half on failure unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Acrobatic Movement
features.description: Without armor or Shield, move across vertical surfaces and liquids during your turn without falling during the movement.

features.name: Heightened Focus
features.description: For 1 Focus Point, Flurry of Blows makes three Unarmed Strikes; Patient Defense also grants Temporary HP equal to two Martial Arts dice; Step of the Wind can carry a willing Large or smaller creature within {{distance:5ft}} without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

features.name: Self-Restoration
features.description: At the end of each turn, end Charmed, Frightened, or Poisoned on yourself. You no longer gain Exhaustion from going without food or drink.

features.name: Deflect Energy
features.description: Deflect Attacks now works against attacks of any damage type.

features.name: Disciplined Survivor
features.description: Gain proficiency in all saving throws. When you fail a save, spend 1 Focus Point to reroll it and use the new result.

features.name: Perfect Focus
features.description: When you roll Initiative without using Uncanny Metabolism, regain Focus Points until you have four if you had three or fewer.

features.name: Superior Defense
features.description: At the start of your turn, spend 3 Focus Points for Resistance to all damage except Force for 1 minute or until Incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Body and Mind
features.description: Increase Dexterity and Wisdom by 4 each; their maximum becomes 25.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: A healing pool equal to 5 x Paladin level replenishes on a Long Rest. As a Bonus Action, touch a creature, including yourself, to restore HP from the pool; spend 5 pool points instead to remove Poisoned.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your Paladin spellcasting ability; a Holy Symbol can be your focus. At level 1, prepare two level 1 Paladin spells; preparation limit and slots increase with Paladin level. After a Long Rest, you can replace one prepared Paladin spell with another of a level you can cast. Always-prepared spells do not count against your limit.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds whose mastery properties you can use. You can change both choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat, or choose Blessed Warrior to learn two Cleric cantrips that count as Paladin spells using Charisma. You can replace one Blessed Warrior cantrip when you gain a Paladin level.

features.name: Paladin's Smite
features.description: Divine Smite is always prepared, and you can cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description: Gain Divine Sense and subclass Channel Divinity options. Start with two uses, increasing to three at Paladin level 11; recover one on a Short Rest and all on a Long Rest. Divine Sense is a Bonus Action that reveals Celestials, Fiends, Undead, and consecrated or desecrated places or objects within {{distance:60ft}} for 10 minutes, until Incapacitated.

features.name: Paladin Subclass
features.description: Choose a Paladin subclass; gain its features at the listed Paladin levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Paladin levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Faithful Steed
features.description: Find Steed is always prepared. Cast it once without a spell slot per Long Rest.

features.name: Aura of Protection
features.description: You and allies in your {{distance:10ft|adj}} emanation gain a saving-throw bonus equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) while you are not Incapacitated. A creature benefits from only one Paladin's Aura of Protection at a time.

features.name: Abjure Foes
features.description: As a Magic action, spend Channel Divinity to target up to your Charisma modifier in creatures (minimum one) within {{distance:60ft}}. Each makes a Wisdom save or becomes Frightened for 1 minute or until damaged; on its turns it can move, take an action, or take a Bonus Action, but only one of those.

features.name: Aura of Courage
features.description: You and allies in your Aura of Protection are immune to Frightened; the condition is suppressed for an affected ally while there.

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Each hit with a Melee weapon or Unarmed Strike deals an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Restoring Touch
features.description: When using Lay On Hands, spend 5 healing-pool points per condition removed: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, or Stunned. Those points do not also heal.

features.name: Aura Expansion
features.description: Aura of Protection extends to a {{distance:30ft|adj}} emanation.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Wisdom is your Ranger spellcasting ability; a Druidic Focus can be your focus. At level 1, prepare two level 1 Ranger spells; preparation limit and slots increase with Ranger level. After a Long Rest, you may replace one prepared Ranger spell with another of a level you can cast. Always-prepared spells do not count against the limit.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Hunter's Mark is always prepared. Cast it without a spell slot twice at levels 1-4, three times at 5-8, four times at 9-12, five times at 13-16, and six times at 17+. Regain free uses on a Long Rest.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds whose mastery properties you can use. Change both choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Deft Explorer
features.description: Gain Expertise in one proficient skill that lacks it, and learn two languages of your choice.

features.name: Fighting Style
features.description: Gain a Fighting Style feat, or choose Druidic Warrior to learn two Druid cantrips that count as Ranger spells using Wisdom. You can replace one Druidic Warrior cantrip when you gain a Ranger level.

features.name: Ranger Subclass
features.description: Choose a Ranger subclass; gain its features at the listed Ranger levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Ranger levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.description: Attack twice whenever you take the Attack action.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Speed increases by {{distance:10ft}} while you are not wearing Heavy armor. Gain Climb and Swim Speeds equal to your Speed.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two more proficient skills that lack it.

features.name: Tireless
features.description: As a Magic action, give yourself 1d8 + Wisdom modifier Temporary HP (minimum 1), a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum one) per Long Rest. A Short Rest also reduces your Exhaustion level by one.

features.name: Relentless Hunter
features.description: Taking damage cannot break your concentration on Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Nature's Veil
features.description: As a Bonus Action, become Invisible until the end of your next turn. Uses equal Wisdom modifier (minimum one) per Long Rest.

features.name: Precise Hunter
features.description: You have Advantage on attacks against the creature marked by your Hunter's Mark.

features.name: Feral Senses
features.description: Gain Blindsight with a range of {{distance:30ft}}.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Foe Slayer
features.description: The damage die of Hunter's Mark becomes a d10 instead of a d6.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Gain Expertise in two proficient skills; gain Expertise in two more at Rogue level 6.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn, deal extra damage with a Finesse or Ranged weapon attack when the attack has Advantage. Advantage is not needed if an ally is within {{distance:5ft}} of the target, is not Incapacitated, and your roll has no Disadvantage. Extra damage is 1d6 at level 1 and increases by 1d6 at each odd Rogue level, reaching 10d6 at level 19.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: Know Thieves' Cant and one other language of your choice.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: Choose two proficient weapon kinds whose mastery properties you can use. Change both choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: On your turn, take Dash, Disengage, or Hide as a Bonus Action.

features.name: Rogue Subclass
features.description: Choose a Rogue subclass; gain its features at the listed Rogue levels.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action before moving, gain Advantage on your next attack roll this turn; your Speed then becomes 0 for the rest of the turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Rogue levels 8, 10, 12, and 16.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: When dealing Sneak Attack damage, forgo 1d6 to add one effect after the damage: Poison (requires a Poisoner's Kit on your person; Constitution save or Poisoned for 1 minute, repeating the save at the end of each turn), Trip (Dexterity save or a Large or smaller target falls Prone), or Withdraw (move up to half your Speed without Opportunity Attacks). Save DC is 8 + Dexterity modifier + Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: As a Reaction when a visible attacker hits you with an attack roll, halve that attack's damage against you, rounded down.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: On a Dexterity save for half damage, take none on success and half on failure unless Incapacitated.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: When an ability check uses a skill or tool proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: Apply up to two Cunning Strike effects to one Sneak Attack, paying each effect's die cost.

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: Gain more Cunning Strike options: Daze costs 2d6 (Constitution save or only move, act, or use a Bonus Action next turn); Knock Out costs 6d6 (Constitution save or Unconscious for up to 1 minute); Obscure costs 3d6 (Dexterity save or Blinded until the end of its next turn).

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: Gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: Attack rolls against you cannot have Advantage unless you are Incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, turn a failed D20 Test into a roll of 20.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Charisma is your Sorcerer spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus can be your focus. Know four Sorcerer cantrips at level 1, gaining another at levels 4 and 10. Prepare two level 1 Sorcerer spells at level 1; preparation limit and slots grow with Sorcerer level. When you gain a Sorcerer level, you may replace one prepared spell and one cantrip with eligible Sorcerer spells.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: As a Bonus Action, unleash innate magic for 1 minute: your Sorcerer spell save DC increases by 1, and you have Advantage on Sorcerer spell attack rolls. Two uses per Long Rest.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: Gain Sorcery Points equal to your Sorcerer level, recovered on a Long Rest. Exchange a spell slot for points equal to its level without an action, or spend points as a Bonus Action to create a slot up to level 5. Slot costs: level 1 costs 2 points, level 2 costs 3, level 3 costs 5, level 4 costs 6, level 5 costs 7; created slots vanish after a Long Rest. You must meet the minimum Sorcerer level for the slot created.

features.name: Metamagic
features.description: Choose two Metamagic options and spend Sorcery Points to modify spells. Normally only one option can affect a spell. Replace an option whenever you gain a Sorcerer level. Learn two more options at level 10 and two more at level 17.

features.name: Sorcerer Subclass
features.description: Choose a Sorcerer subclass; gain its features at the listed Sorcerer levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Sorcerer levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Sorcerous Restoration
features.description: Once per Long Rest after finishing a Short Rest, regain spent Sorcery Points up to half your Sorcerer level, rounded down.

features.name: Sorcery Incarnate
features.description: If out of Innate Sorcery uses, spend 2 Sorcery Points when activating it. While Innate Sorcery is active, apply up to two Metamagic options to each spell.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Arcane Apotheosis
features.description: While Innate Sorcery is active, one Metamagic option on each of your turns costs no Sorcery Points.

features.name: Eldritch Invocations
features.description: Learn one eligible Eldritch Invocation at level 1. Whenever you gain a Warlock level, you may replace one invocation if doing so does not invalidate another prerequisite. The number known rises with Warlock level, reaching ten at level 18; you cannot choose the same invocation twice unless it permits it.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Charisma is your Warlock spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus can be your focus. Know two Warlock cantrips at level 1, gaining another at levels 4 and 10. Prepare two level 1 Warlock spells at level 1; preparation limit and uniform Pact Magic slot level rise with Warlock level. Recover Pact Magic slots on a Short or Long Rest. Replace one prepared spell and one cantrip when you gain a Warlock level.

features.name: Magical Cunning
features.description: Once per Long Rest, perform a 1-minute rite to regain spent Pact Magic slots, up to half your maximum number rounded up.

features.name: Warlock Subclass
features.description: Choose a Warlock subclass; gain its features at the listed Warlock levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Warlock levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Contact Patron
features.description: Contact Other Plane is always prepared. Once per Long Rest, cast it without a spell slot to contact your patron and automatically succeed on its saving throw.

features.name: Mystic Arcanum
features.description: Choose one level 6 Warlock spell to cast once per Long Rest without a slot. Gain a separate level 7 arcanum at Warlock level 13, level 8 at 15, and level 9 at 17, each with its own free casting. When gaining a Warlock level, replace one arcanum with a different eligible Warlock spell of the same level.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Eldritch Master
features.description: Magical Cunning now restores all your expended Pact Magic slots.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: Intelligence is your Wizard spellcasting ability; an Arcane Focus or spellbook can be your focus. Know three Wizard cantrips at level 1, gaining another at levels 4 and 10; replace one after a Long Rest. Your spellbook starts with six level 1 Wizard spells and gains two eligible Wizard spells each Wizard level. Prepare four spells from the book at level 1; the limit and slots grow with level. After a Long Rest, you may replace any prepared spells with eligible spells from your book.

features.name: Ritual Adept
features.description: Cast a Ritual-tagged Wizard spell from your spellbook as a Ritual without preparing it, while reading from the book.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Once per Long Rest after a Short Rest, recover spell slots whose combined levels do not exceed half your Wizard level rounded up; no recovered slot may be level 6 or higher.

features.name: Scholar
features.description: Gain Expertise in one proficient skill you choose from Arcana, History, Investigation, Medicine, Nature, or Religion.

features.name: Wizard Subclass
features.description: Choose a Wizard subclass; gain its features at the listed Wizard levels.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat for which you qualify. Gain this feature again at Wizard levels 8, 12, and 16.

features.name: Memorize Spell
features.description: After a Short Rest, replace one prepared level 1+ Wizard spell with another level 1+ spell in your spellbook.

features.name: Spell Mastery
features.description: Choose a level 1 and a level 2 action-casting spell from your spellbook. They are always prepared and can each be cast at their lowest level without a slot. After a Long Rest, replace one choice with another eligible spell of the same level.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: Gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat for which you qualify.

features.name: Signature Spells
features.description: Choose two level 3 spells in your spellbook. They are always prepared, and each can be cast once at level 3 without a slot per Short or Long Rest.
